title: Toque´n Chef
tagline: Recipe license management and royalties payment automation for Chefs.
description: Create, sell or collect Chef's recipes. A marketplace to Mint Recipe's as NFTS, and license or sell them to restaurants and consumers.  Food industry is very fast paced, with incredibly tight margins. Any automation and additional revenue can make it easier.  Buy and Sell Recipes, Create Collections, Build a Following through memberships and subscriptions.
how_its_made: ERC1155 with some custom logic to hide recipes until the are purchased. The ERC1155 acts as the users Collection, and individual tokens are recipes that are used to unlock access. Deployed to Polygon for Speed, with URIs stored on IPFS via nft.storage for decentralization and persistence. Minimum Viable Proxy Pattern planned to minimum cost; each user is their own ERC1155 instance.
